line: Prabhu, Aries ka 2027 likhne se pehle zara meri baat sun lijiye. Main Aries walon ki wakeel hun.
Mesh walon ko wakeel ki nahi, brake ki zaroorat hai.
Waise is saal Shani dev ki Sade Sati chal rahi hai.
Saade saat saal? Prabhu, teen kar dijiye na, bas teen!
Shani dev mol-bhaav nahi karte, jitni mehnat utna phal. Aur Guru saath hain, ghabrao mat.
March-April aur August se October tak sehat ka thoda dhyaan rakhna. July mein toh ekdum fit rahoge.
Toh July mein gym join kar lete hain!
Join toh har saal karte hain, is baar jaana bhi padega.
Office mein kaam ka pressure rahega, aur koi na koi boss ke kaan bharega.
Naam bataiye, abhi notice bhejti hun!
Notice-votice chhodo. April-May aur September-October mein naukri chhodne ka risk mat lena.
Paisa theek-thaak se behtar rahega, March-April aur June mein sabse badhiya.
Toh Ferrari?
FD.
June se November tak pyaar mein Guru ka saath hai.
Waah!
Bas August-October mein behas mat karna. Wakeel sahiba, ab iska bhi discount chahiye?
Mesh wale aur bina behas ke? Haan Prabhu, chahiye!
Aur ghar mein badon ki baat dil pe mat lena.
Mummy ki daant bhi?
Wo daant nahi, prasad hai, sar aankhon pe.
Karna bas itna hai: Mangalwar ko Sundarkand padho, chaandi pehno, aur kisi netraheen ko pyaar se khana khilao.
Aur is saal brake bhi lagana, aur gym bhi jaana.
Case jeet gaye! Apne Aries dost ko ye bhej do, mahine-wise poori guide link mein hai.
